params.1273: Prosecute or defend the accused of RuneScape before a jury of their peers.
params.1292: Gives experience in Attack or Defence.
params.1274: You must find court summons to take up a case.
params.1275: Talk to the clerk at the Seers' Village courthouse to learn more.
params.1276: You require level 65 Attack to prosecute and 65 Defence to defend a client.
